main_body: Wooden lectern box (x7-39, rows 12-45) with an orange overhanging top, a recessed red book panel with a gold cross, and a stepped staircase with a railing beside it
top_band: Light orange band, rows 13-15 (about 4 rows with the darker back and front edge rows), wider than the body and overhanging it, sitting above the brown front face
evidence: In the middle column, rows 12-16 are a light orange top that overhangs the body, with a darker row 16 under its front edge acting as an eave shadow. Below that, the front face (rows 17-41) is a darker brown with a dark inset frame around the red panel, and a dark base plinth sits at rows 42-45. The top band is thin but clearly lighter than the face and spans the full width, comparable to the guide cabinet, so it reads as a foreshortened top surface. The stairs on the right are a secondary detail.

style.evidence: The outlines are a dark brown tinted to the wood, which is good. The wood ramp has about 4 steps and the stair ramp has about 3-4. The red panel is a large, nearly flat fill of about 15x14 px with only a cross and a left highlight. The stair faces and the front frame are also mostly flat areas with few grain dots, and the staircase reads as simple stepped blocks. Next to the cheese stall and the roofed well, which carry scalloped tile highlights, stone-by-stone shading and speckle, it is flatter and carries fewer colours per tile.
